prompts.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Edit/recompose the supplied visual references into a new Chinese Android Automotive teaching comic. Reference image 1 is ONLY the fixed character identity; reference image 2 is ONLY the white-background blue mechanical-comic style. Replace ALL old technical content and layout. Pure white background, crisp blue thin mechanical panel frames with subtle rivets, restrained device/file icons, dark navy highly legible Chinese and English labels, substantial whitespace. Landscape PNG, target 2048x1152 or larger. No overall title, no subtitle, no chapter number, no watermark, no speech bubble. Exactly ONE complete small whale girl in lower-right empty margin, body height about 12% of canvas and strictly <=15%, blue long hair with pale tips, curved ahoge, whale-fin ears, blue eyes, blue-white maid dress, white ruffled apron, cyan ribbon, white socks, dark blue shoes, small whale tail; same identity as reference 1, pose adapted to explanation. Character and pointer must not overlap any technical panel, label or arrow. Green solid directed arrows mean PCM audio data; orange directed arrows mean control/decision; blue dashed arrows mean configuration/constraint. Show a compact legend only for arrow types actually used. Arrow directions must be exact and never invented or bidirectional. No tiny code or extra invented labels. Explain audio data vs focus control and correct process boundaries with TWO clearly separated horizontal bands. Upper band label "焦点控制". Four distinct outlined boxes in one row: "App" containing "AudioManager"; "system_server" containing two stacked labels "AudioService" and "MediaFocusControl"; "CarService" containing "CarZonesAudioFocus" and "CarAudioFocus"; a small final state card "按 zone 仲裁". Orange arrows go App -> system_server labeled "请求焦点", system_server -> CarService labeled "外部焦点策略", CarService -> state card. Under this band one short note "焦点许可不等于已经播放". Lower band label "PCM 数据". Four boxes left-to-right: "App / AudioTrack" -> "audioserver / AudioFlinger" -> "Audio HAL" -> "DSP / 功放 / 扬声器", linked green PCM arrows. In audioserver box also a separate small label "AudioPolicyService / APM" annotated "选路" without a green arrow through APM. Separate small control box above hardware at lower right labeled "AudioControl HAL" with ONE orange incoming arrow from a small "CarService：duck / mute 信号" label and ONE orange arrow toward DSP box. AudioControl HAL MUST NOT be in the green PCM chain. Do not draw ordinary volume APIs terminating at AudioControl HAL. Whale girl holds a small pointer toward the empty gap between the two bands. All long English names line-wrap cleanly. Only include specified content.
